Thank you for confirming that your quote for the checkout clean at Flat 2, 172 Alder Lane, Bellmere, ZZ3 1ZZ (ref R/PM004-1) has been sent. Unfortunately we can't see it on our job record yet.

Could you please reply to this email with the quote attached (or the price in the body), quoting reference R/PM004-1? It should cover:
- Living space: vacuum and light clean
- En-suite: limescale removal

Please don't attend or start work until we confirm the quote has been approved.

Many thanks,
Northbridge Lettings
